definition.title: Get your product into the resources juniors share
definition.description: For products students or early-career professionals discover through someone a step ahead, find public junior-resource lists from alumni or seniors at target campuses, rank them by fit and reach, and draft a personal note for the founder to send.

focus.title: Campus or program to focus on (optional)
focus.description: Narrow the search to a campus, degree program, bootcamp, or professional training program. Leave empty to use target audiences already named in Tin.

prerequisites.reason: The onboarding plan identifies the buyer, target campuses or programs, and hard no's that constrain the research and draft.
The Feature map grounds the product fit and any claims in the note.
The captured writing style guide shapes the personal note drafted for the founder.
